sections.title: 1. Seams are test-only, canonical, assertion-preserving - PASS
lines: - `git diff --numstat e6d1553ce HEAD -- src` is `10 0` for each of the ten suites and nothing else under `src/`. Each file has exactly one hunk, `@@ -N,0 +N+1,10 @@`, and no deletions even under `-w`. No mode or rename changes, no CRs, and `git diff --check` is clean.

- Ignoring the hunk header line numbers, the added text is the same 10 lines in all ten files: comment, `jest.mock('@/lib/multiplayer/server/fogMatchAdmission', () => ({ ...jest.requireActual<typeof import(...)>(...), noPerViewerRevealProjection: () => false, matchLacksRevealProjection: async () => false, }));` and a blank line. Each block sits after the import block, before the first declaration.

- All ten files are under `__tests__/`. `jest.mock` only exists inside the Jest runtime, so production cannot reach it. The `requireActual` spread keeps `FOG_REFUSAL` and every other real export, and only the two predicates are overridden.

- `matchLacksRevealProjection` does not exist in production `fogMatchAdmission.ts` on this base. It is supplied only by the override until B14-0 adds it, so the extra key is harmless today. The simulation candidate's async `false|policy|unavailable` form is compatible (71/71, below).
